name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension
definition: The **monotonic co-VC dimension** is the subfamily-monotonic envelope of co-VC dimension: $$\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H):=\max_{\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H}\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G).$$
description: The largest hollow-star dimension obtainable after discarding concepts.
graph_summary: Largest co-VC dimension among subfamilies; a doubly monotonic hollow-star parameter.

monotonic.proof: Every subfamily of a subfamily of $\mathcal H$ is also a subfamily of $\mathcal H$, so enlarging $\mathcal H$ can only enlarge the defining maximum.

p_monotonic.proof: For every subfamily of a projection $\mathcal H_{|S}$, select one preimage in $\mathcal H$ for each projected concept. It is the projection of a subfamily $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H$. Projection-monotonicity of co-VC gives $\mathrm{coVC}((\mathcal H_{|S})')\le\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)$.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is a subfamily restriction followed by a projection, and the preceding two established properties apply.

doubly_monotonic.proof: It is both subfamily-monotonic and projection-monotonic by the displayed direct arguments.
